description: Change of use of the vacant retail unit for use of commercial, business and services (Use Class E)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Site Location Plan, 546_751 Rev C, Cover Letter, Fire Safety Statement received 20 October 2023..

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the submitted details, the premises shall not be used as Class E(f) (Cr?che, day nursery or day centre (not including a residential use)), E(g)(ii) (Research and development of products or processes) and E(g)(iii) (Industrial processes) without prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of any use under Class E(d) (Indoor sport, recreation or fitness (not involving motorised vehicles or firearms or use as a swimming pool or skating rink,)) a scheme for protecting the approved development from noise associated with the use has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The submitted details shall include full details of a scheme to insulate the premises against internally generated airborne and impact sound to the residential accommodation above. The approved scheme shall be completed before the development is first occupied or brought into use and be retained as such thereafter.
